name: tuck l-sit
description: A support hold with the hips and feet off the floor and the knees pulled toward the chest. It is the first fully lifted L-sit position.
instructions: Sit on the floor or between parallettes with your hands beside your hips.
Bend your knees and pull them toward your chest.
Lock your arms and push down to lift your hips and feet.
Keep your shoulders pressed down and your back tall.
